'''IK-4C''' was the designation of a combat [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] deployed to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Stationed in the Imperial Intelligence Gadget Warehouse, he was reprogrammed by [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Trace (SIS)|Trace]], who planted in him a subroutine preventing him from harming Republic citizens. Trace also used the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for secure remote holo-communications.<ref name="TOR" />
